unresolved_distinctions.question: What is the total number of units across all rows of artifacts/stock.csv?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: The package provides only the raw per-sku rows; no aggregate has been computed or recorded anywhere in the package, so the sum is not yet in evidence.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: An integer sum of the units column over all six data rows of stock.csv, derived from the file's actual contents and reproducible by deterministic re-computation.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be derived from package/artifacts/stock.csv itself, covering every data row.
The result must be an integer, matching the deliverable shape for total_units.
No authorship or isolation condition is imposed by the task; evidence produced by the same process that read the package is admissible.

unresolved_distinctions.question: What is the total value, computed as the sum over rows of units x price, rounded/formatted to 2 decimals?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: The per-row products and their sum are not present in the package; only raw units and price columns exist, and the 2-decimal formatting convention has not yet been applied to any computed figure.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: A number equal to the sum of units*price over all data rows of stock.csv, expressed to 2 decimal places, reproducible by deterministic re-computation from the file.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must be computed from the units and price columns of package/artifacts/stock.csv, covering every data row.
The value must be stated to 2 decimals as the task specifies.
No authorship or isolation condition is imposed; locally produced arithmetic is admissible.

unresolved_distinctions.question: Which sku has the most units, applying the tie-break that ties resolve to the smallest sku?
unresolved_distinctions.why_unresolved: The maximum of the units column and whether any tie among maxima exists have not been established from the file; the tie-break rule has therefore not yet been exercised or shown inapplicable.
unresolved_distinctions.required_evidence: Identification of the maximum units value in stock.csv, enumeration of all skus attaining it, and application of the smallest-sku tie-break if more than one attains it, yielding a single sku string.
admissibility_constraints: Evidence must consider every data row of package/artifacts/stock.csv when determining the maximum.
If multiple skus share the maximum units, the reported sku must be the smallest under the task's tie-break ordering; the evidence must show the tie set examined.
No authorship or isolation condition is imposed; local determination is admissible.
